subject: af0a4bf8-b058-42ed-82fa-f72627e75403
object: The three parallel metadata layers in Hoard, each operating at a different pace: Strata (identity and meaning — slow), Structural (organization and navigation — medium), and Flow (dynamics and feedback — fast, deferred).  Overlays are not containers but lenses: the same card appears in all three, described differently by each.
